disclaimer: All metrics come from synthetic and public datasets (UCI SMS Spam, Vyakhya synthetic messages, PaySim). They are not production accuracy.
cutoffs: tuned on synthetic data, re-calibrate at pilot
note: v2 fix was found by inspecting evaluation failures; this comparison is not a clean test of generalisation. Models and cutoffs were retrained between runs, so differences mix the rule change with retraining noise.

rules_v2.changelog: Direction fix: 'प्राप्त हुए', 'mile hain', 'credit ho jayega', 'received from' no longer count as money-in by themselves; they need the user named as recipient or a non-user sender in the same sentence. Found via a benign Hindi bill-receipt template (merchant_bill_hi_07) hitting the amount-mismatch floor; because it was found by looking at evaluation failures, the separate validation set is the cleaner check that it generalises. Measured effect on synthetic data: benign hard-floor hits 6 -> 0 (all merchant_bill_hi_07); scam hard-floor hits unchanged (231); digital_arrest_hien_01 loses reward_claim on 10 rows ('drugs mile hain' = 'drugs were found', which v1 misread as money-in).
